answer: Each epoch a verifier draws one prior claim and issues fresh seed, forcing author to re-derive reasoning live in under 90 seconds; solver attaches a copper-signed trace hash so pre-baked answers fail. First mismatch flags identity, second within 30 days freezes emission and routes stake to a nebula of rotating auditors, capping any single fake at the 5000-token challenge cost. Sustaining 20,000 parallel identities requires 100 million tokens and roughly $46,000 monthly, pushing forgery past the zenith of profitable fraud.
